build_point_head_simple: build a PointHeadSimple instance with num_class, input_channels, and model_cfg for PV-RCNN point segmentation
run_forward_point_head: run the PointHeadSimple forward pass on a batch_dict to get point classification scores
assign_targets_point_head: assign ground truth targets to point coordinates using assign_targets with gt_boxes and point_coords
get_loss_point_head: get the classification layer loss from PointHeadSimple for training with a tb_dict for logging
review_point_head_simple_class: review the PointHeadSimple class and its FC layers for point-based 3D object detection segmentation
